object_types.name: Reviewer
object_types.definition: A person who reviews papers for the conference.

source_references.excerpt: Reviewers have a reviewer ID.

object_types.name: Paper
object_types.definition: A paper submitted to the conference that gets reviewed.

source_references.excerpt: Papers have a paper number.

object_types.name: Review
object_types.definition: The act of a particular reviewer reviewing a particular paper, tracked as its own entity with a score.

source_references.excerpt: each completed review gets its own review ID -- we treat the review itself as a thing we track.

object_types.name: ReviewScore
object_types.definition: The overall rating given in a review, on a scale of 1 to 5.

source_references.excerpt: The review score is always one of 1, 2, 3, 4, or 5.
Reviewers review papers. A reviewer can review many papers, and each paper gets several reviewers, but a given reviewer reviews a given paper at most once.
